items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: But he was smart and he was glib and he was learned and he was school-smart and street-smart. I learned a lot from him. A lot from him.

ctx.x: He was absolutely brilliant. He was a spectacular musician. Real hall of famer, right up there with the best of whoever did it. But he was smart and he was glib and he was learned and he was school-smart and street-smart. I learned a lot from him. A lot from him. A lot of guys resented his commercial success. They said he was a cop out or stuff like that. Let me tell you something. From the beginning when he and Nat first went out, you know with —
